# Complete Lovable UI/UX Redesign

I have completely refactored your application to use the precise, clean, and border-driven aesthetics of the provided Lovable project, replacing the previous "Apple Health/Tesla" gradients.

## 1. Global Shadcn Architecture (`index.css`)
I removed all of the heavy glassmorphism utilities and replaced them with standard Lovable/shadcn CSS variables (using exact HSL values).
- `bg-background`, `bg-card`, `bg-popover`
- `text-foreground`, `text-muted-foreground`
- `border-border`
- Standardized `primary` and `secondary` accent colors.

## 2. Customer Dashboard Refactor (`Dashboard.tsx`)
- Stripped away the blurred blobs, Tesla backgrounds, and heavy UI components.
- Converted all sections (Active Boarding, Pet Profile, Timeline, Today's Updates) into crisp, Lovable-style cards.
- Integrated `shadcn` styling (`bg-card`, `border`, `rounded-xl`, `shadow-sm`) while keeping all your Supabase live-data bindings perfectly intact.

## 3. Partner Dashboard Refactor (`PartnerDashboard.tsx`)
- Migrated the Partner Portal to utilize the global Lovable variables.
- Converted the Stripe-style layout to match the clean Lovable aesthetic (`border-border`, `bg-secondary` tags).
- Updated the main wrapper from hardcoded hex colors to dynamic `bg-background` and `bg-card`.

## 4. App Layout Updates (`AppLayout.tsx` & `PartnerLayout.tsx`)
- Adjusted the core wrappers to consume the global Lovable variables to ensure the entire site feels cohesive and premium without hardcoded background colors.

> [!NOTE]
> The entire frontend design now adheres to the Lovable template standard you requested. Your data and functional logic remain completely unchanged and secure.

# UI Architecture Evolution

I have completed the structural migration to the **Lovable Design System**.

## 1. Global CSS Variable Foundation
I've updated `src/index.css` to act as the single source of truth for your new design system.
I replaced the ad-hoc premium gradients and glass classes with standard `shadcn/ui` style variables:
- Built out `background`, `foreground`, `card`, `popover`, `primary`, `secondary`, `muted`, `accent`, `border`, and `ring` tokens using clean HSL values.
- These variables form the foundation for the Lovable border-driven, clean-card aesthetic.

## 2. Layout Structure Fixes
I resolved the overlapping issues you experienced in the Partner Dashboard:
- Removed hardcoded `min-h-screen` constraints that were forcing content to overlap within the main `PartnerLayout`.
- Removed unnecessary sticky positioning that conflicted with the scroll container.
- Cleaned up the flex layout so the internal tables scale naturally.

> [!NOTE]
> I have set up the core infrastructure. The next steps involve migrating individual pages (Customer Dashboard, Partner Dashboard) to use these new standardized variables.
